topic: Harmful Effects of Light and Sound
key_concepts: Light and sound are forms of energy that affect daily life
Loud sounds or noise can damage hearing
Hearing damage risk increases with louder sounds and longer exposure time
Common loud noises include karaoke, firecrackers, and loudspeakers
Loud noise can cause trouble sleeping, difficulty hearing others, and ear discomfort
Moving away, covering ears, and lowering volume help protect ears from loud sounds
Earplugs and earmuffs are devices that reduce sound and protect hearing
Natural light comes from sources like the Sun; artificial light comes from sources like li
Too much sunlight exposure can cause sunburn, tiredness, and heat-related illness
Eye strain, skin cancer, and heat stroke are possible harmful health effects of light
Glare is very bright light that makes it hard to see
Artificial light, including blue light, can also have harmful effects on health
